en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Muawiya Bin Wahab who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the yawning during the Azān and the Iqamah, so heasws said: ‘Weasws do not recognise (experience) it’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahab who has said the following: “
I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about tathwib (yawning) in Adhan and ‘Iqamah. He (the Imam) said, ‘We do not know it (experience it).”’
